div.div: شَوْكَآءُ , applied to a [garment such as is called] بُرْدَة, (S, O,) or to a [garment or dress such as is called] حُلَّة, (A, O, K,) (tropical:) Rough to the feel, because new: (AO, S, O, K, TA:) but As said, “ I know not what it is. ” (O, L, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
